title: Drumboogie and tunes he wrote for Gene
summary: Roy composed tunes that Gene recorded, such as Drumboogie, without receiving royalties.

story.theme_name: Getting paid for records: royalties, publishing and flat fees
story.community_name: Royalties, publishing and who owns the song

blocks.x: Well, that's when they had the strike with BMI and ASCAP...

And I had a tune which was called "Won't You Sit And Rear Back." I think Frank gave it the name, "Drumboogie." It got the tune for me, "Drumboogie." Somebody put the words to it; I don't know who it was.

But you see what happened, I should have been making money way back there. They got "Drumboogie" out for me, and I had a tune called "We Open," which was made when Gene recorded, "It's That Drummer's Band." That was like his theme song. Now, you realize all the residuals that I'd have got off of that if they had really...I mean, royalties, if they had given me what I was supposed to get, you know. "How About That Mess(?)", that was another one.
Yeah. Oh, there was about five or six tunes that I did that have been recorded, and he got a lot of play out of them, you know.
